identity: A travel booking widget with seat maps, stay dates, flight and hotel results, and controls for changing an existing booking.

scenarios.name: seat
scenarios.screen: A seat map shows numbered rows with six lettered seats per row, including occupied seats and exit rows. The passenger and flight details are filled in; no seat is selected.
never: A seat is already selected for the passenger.
An occupied seat is shown as available.
A hotel calendar or hotel results list is open.

arrangements.text: Row numbers sit beside the seat grid, with seat letters above it and the seat details beside the grid.
The seat grid sits above the seat details, with row numbers along its left edge and seat letters across its top.

scenarios.name: daterange
scenarios.screen: The destination and guest are filled in, while the check-in and check-out fields are empty. The two-month date picker is closed.
never: A check-in or check-out date is selected.
A stay total is shown as a completed booking.

arrangements.text: The check-in field sits to the left of the check-out field, with the destination and guest details above them.
The check-in field sits above the check-out field, with the destination and guest details above both fields.

scenarios.name: flights
scenarios.screen: The route appears above a list of flight options, each with an airline, departure time, stops and price. No flight is selected, and the airline menu is closed.
never: A flight is already selected or booked.
A hotel amenity checklist appears in the flight results.

arrangements.text: Flight controls sit above the results, and the flight options run down the page beneath them.
Flight controls sit beside the results, and the flight options run down the page in the adjoining column.

scenarios.name: hotels
scenarios.screen: The destination appears with price, rating and amenity filters beside a list of hotel options. Each option shows a nightly price, guest rating and amenities; no hotel is selected.
never: Hotel cards sit outside the results area.

arrangements.text: Price, rating and amenity filters run down one side of the hotel list, with hotel options stacked in the wider area beside them.
Price, rating and amenity filters sit above the hotel list, with hotel options stacked below.

scenarios.name: change
scenarios.screen: The existing booking shows its reference, passenger, departure date and seat, with an edit control. The booking has not been changed, and the edit and review pages are closed.
never: A review of changed details is already displayed.

arrangements.text: The booking reference and passenger sit above the departure date and seat, with the edit control below the booking details.
The booking reference and passenger sit beside the departure date and seat, with the edit control beneath that row.
